item.title: Hong Kong authorities arrest 8 over alleged insider trading involving brokerages, hedge fund
item.description: Hong Kong’s anti-graft watchdog and financial regulator have arrested eight people and raided the offices of three firms over suspected insider dealing and corruption worth HK$315 million in illicit profits. item.title: Hong Kong’s Cathay Pacific to double fuel surcharges amid Mideast war
item.description: Hong Kong’s flagship carrier Cathay Pacific has announced that fuel surcharges for all flights will more than double next week, due to soaring oil prices amid the war in the Middle East. The surcharge increase will apply to all flight tickets purchased on Wednesday next week and later, the airline said on Thursday. For short-haul […]

item.title: China-North Korea train arrives in Pyongyang after 6-year pause
item.description: A passenger train from China arrived in the North Korean capital on Thursday, state media said, after a six-year hiatus since the service was suspended during the Covid-19 pandemic. item.description: Records show that journalist Selina Cheng was terminated by the Wall Street Journal due to redundancy, a top human resources executive for the newspaper’s parent company has told a Hong Kong court. item.description: Close to 4,000 athletes, celebrities and families gathered at the Hong Kong Science Park early Sunday morning, March 1, to join MSF’s large-scale running and orienteering competition and to support its international medical humanitarian work. item.description: Landlords may spend at least HK$15,000 to have up to four subdivided units certified under the new law stipulating minimum living standards for shoebox flats in Hong Kong, a surveyors’ association has said.
